grid_rules.description: Each # is one logical 5x3 floor section and one possible actor position. Adjacent sections share their outside edge, so actor centers repeat on a 4x2 stride. Backticks are shared interior lattice intersections, not actor centers.

lattice_marker.location: shared southeast/northeast/southwest/northwest corner of four neighboring floor sections

grid_rules.mask_semantics: Each # is one usable floor section and possible character position.

room_shell_rules.description: A room with N logical floor columns has N north-wall spans and N+1 north boundary points. It therefore shows N-1 interior backtick columns.
The east wall sits beyond the final logical actor center and does not occlude a centered one-character actor in the reference fixture.

occlusion_rules.description: Logical entities remain assigned to floor sections when foreground walls cover their projected centers. Opaque mode retains the wall glyph; x-ray mode replaces that glyph with a dim lowercase entity.

covered_section_centers.east_wall: none for a centered one-character actor

display_rules.opaque: retain wall glyph and mark entity hidden
display_rules.xray: replace wall glyph with a dim lowercase entity while retaining wall metadata
display_rules.walls_removed_comparison: lowercase may mark sections revealed by removing foreground walls

notes: Promote only approved recurring corrections into this file.
Keep full one-off target artwork in style_samples/targets.
